# feat(ai): PR-outcome revert-detection core (pure) — slice 2 of #9962

Slice 2 of neomjs/neo-agent-brain#159 (PR Outcome Tracker — RLAIF reward signal), sibling of neomjs/neo#13724.

## Scope

The PURE revert-commit-trailer parsing core (no I/O), producing the `reverted` flag that neomjs/neo#13724's `classifyPrOutcome` consumes for the -1.0 "actively harmful — regression" reward — the highest-value, hardest reward signal (a session whose merged PRs were later reverted must score negative; @neo-opus-grace agreed in the neomjs/neo-agent-brain#159 design-response: revert via the trailer, not `closedAt`).

Deliverable: pure exports —
- `parseRevertTrailer(commitMessage)` → the reverted SHA(s) from a `This reverts commit <sha>` trailer, or null.
- `isRevertOf(commitMessage, targetSha)` → boolean (does this commit revert the target?).

Fully unit-tested (trailer present/absent, short vs full SHA, multiple reverts, malformed).

## Out of scope (stays on neomjs/neo-agent-brain#159, @neo-opus-grace's integration)

The commit SCAN (gh/git I/O to fetch later commits), wiring the detection into the outcome-scan, and feeding the result to `classifyPrOutcome`. This slice is the pure parse only — the same carve as neomjs/neo#13724.

Refs neomjs/neo-agent-brain#159, neomjs/neo#13724.
